message: Renovate proposes major updates after 1 day (minimumReleaseAge: "1 day" in packageRules[1] of renovate.json), but pnpm waits 3 days (minimumReleaseAge: 4320 in pnpm-workspace.yaml); its pull requests bring in versions younger than pnpm accepts, or fail where the lockfile is re-checked
fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[1] of renovate.json at least 3 days, or limit the rule to the packages that need a shorter delay
